रेस्टोरेंट में ग्राहक कैसे बढ़ाएं? Khana achha hai, phir bhi restaurant khaali? Galti khane mein nahi, in teen cheezon mein hai. 🍽️

1. Menu bahut lamba: sau dishes dekhkar grahak uljhta hai. Jo sabse zyada bikti hain unhe upar, bada karke rakhiye. Har dish ke aage saaf daam likhiye.

2. Google Maps par photos nahi: naya grahak pehle phone par khana dekhta hai. Best dishes ki saaf roshni mein photo lijiye aur Google Business Profile par daal dijiye.

3. Pehli baar aaye grahak ko wapas bulane ka tareeka nahi: bill dete waqt WhatsApp number maangiye. Agle hafte nayi dish ki photo bhejiye.

Save kar lijiye, aur restaurant wale dost ko bhejiye. Comment mein bataiye, aapke menu mein kitni dishes hain? 👇
